prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Learn How to Interact with Your Pet", "Try moving, summoning, and toggling your desktop pet with these quick desktop shortcuts.", "Right-click your pet anytime to bring up controls and settings.", "Practice pet controls"]
1: ["Your desktop companion is being crafted and personalized right now.", "Generating pet animations and desktop behaviors"]
2: ["Design Your Custom Desktop Companion", "Select your photo or avatar style for high accuracy and instant desktop rendering.", "Our AI renderer is matching your pet's features!"]
3: []
4: ["Choose Desktop Spot for Your Pet", "Pick whether your pet floats on top of windows, rests on your taskbar, or stays in the tray.", "Desktop Placement Options"]
5: ["Find Your Ideal Pet Path in 2 Questions", "Answer two quick questions to auto-select the best companion experience for your desktop."]
6: ["Signing into your existing account automatically restores all your previously adopted desktop pets and progress.", "Account Recovery Active"]
7: ["Select Your Pet's Personality", "Choose how active, playful, or quiet your desktop companion will be during your workday.", "Personality Traits"]
8: ["Your pet will launch directly to your desktop. Look for the system tray icon if minimized.", "Desktop Tray Status: Readying"]
9: ["Your Companion is Ready to Play!", "Click on the buttons below to command your pet on desktop before finishing onboarding.", "Test Pet Call Command"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for user photo, which is personal information.
